complete_data_auditor.input: All 53 exact original reconstructed files, the immutable timing manifest/19 source bodies and prior prepared full leaf maps; no Python or product execution.

interpretation.observed: The same prototype speeds the larger matched synthetic joins but regresses small joins and the unmatched-source helper diagnostics. All five pairs, all three key-temperature modes and every original timing sample are retained; no failing or slow cell is discarded.
interpretation.ratios: Candidate divided by baseline; paired median and nearest-rank p95 recomputed from each arm's 20 samples. Reported ranges span five matched pairs and are not confidence intervals or pooled cross-cell ratios.
interpretation.actual_caller_prework: The actual caller already filters primary sources using a snapshot-ID set before the measured join and returns earlier when no snapshots exist. Isolated cold keys, unmatched-source inputs and S=0 are diagnostic helper populations, not claimed reachable default-route workloads.
interpretation.warm_scope: Warm cells reuse their own constructed stock-record population after one untimed oracle-checked join. They remain synthetic isolated joins, even though prehashed keys better match the caller boundary.
interpretation.process_scope: Each arm is a separate owned CPython 3.12.13 process with identical same-pair PYTHONHASHSEED, exact decimal-string hash sentinels and declared -P -s -B flags. Process freshness is not cold CPU cache, a machine reboot or independent hardware.
interpretation.timing_boundaries: Only the exact source-derived join is between the two process-CPU and wall-clock reads. Input construction, product imports, output identity checking and result destruction occur outside that interval. Clock-read overhead remains in the samples; no subtraction or warmup-result discard was used.
interpretation.diagnostic_memory: The two separate traced diagnostic processes observed only live-at-return shallow CPython container sizes. They exclude keys/record payloads, peak allocation, RSS, physical bytes and total process-tree memory.
interpretation.original_acceptance: RSP-130 still depends on RSP-011/RSP-012 and actual traversal/third-party scanner/cloud-wait separation plus the declared 24/128/486-file route campaign. The >=30% improvement and <=5% regression whole-workload selection rule is unchanged. Missing actual scanner/cloud work is not a measured NO-GO.
interpretation.no_source_selection: No production threshold or change is chosen from these observations. The original callback, fallback, ACK, client_unverified provenance and commit contracts remain separate prerequisites.
